page_title: Bootstrap Studio - The Revolutionary Web Design Tool

sources.entry: Bootstrap Studio - A powerful desktop app for creating responsive websites using the Bootstrap framework.

summary.name: Bootstrap Studio
summary.one_liner: Bootstrap Studio is a desktop app for visually designing, exporting, and publishing responsive websites built on the Bootstrap framework, without writing code.
use_cases: Designing responsive websites visually without writing code
Building client websites as static HTML for any host
Prototyping pages and apps with Bootstrap components
Learning web design step by step
Creating forms that send submissions by email
Publishing a site to a server via SFTP
summary.what_it_does: Bootstrap Studio is a desktop app that runs locally and works offline, using drag and drop with visual controls to build pages on Bootstrap 3, 4, or 5. It includes a library of templates and components such as headers, footers, and galleries, plus Google Fonts and vector icon libraries. Animations can be triggered on scroll or hover, and Lottie and parallax effects are supported. Projects are saved as bsdesign files and exported as static HTML with local assets, and the page also mentions a code editor with SASS, JavaScript, JSON, and HTML support and an AI Assistant that requires your own API key.
notable: One-time purchase desktop app that works fully offline, with no usage limits or ongoing fees
Bootstrap 3, 4 and 5 fully supported, exports static HTML
Built-in AI Assistant (unlimited use with your own API key) and optional 5 free hosting slots
Standard and Lifetime editions include free premium templates; Lifetime includes all future versions free
caveats: Paid product; the page advertises limited-time bonus templates with purchase
The AI Assistant requires your own API key
The page does not name specific operating systems; it only describes a desktop app (listing mentions macOS via awesome-mac)
